title: Establishment of a Patient Library in Patients With Pruritus Sine Materia
official: Establishment of a Patient Library in Patients With Pruritus Sine Materia
summary: Very little is currently known about the pathophysiology of pruritus sine materia according to the etiology. The creation of this cohort should make it possible to improve our clinical and biological knowledge according to the etiology, by collecting blood, skin, feces, and clinical data.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Diagnosis of pruritus sine materia
* Collection of consent
* Adult

Exclusion Criteria:

\- Refusal to participate in the study
